guidance.source_quote: We expect total revenue of $19.4 to $19.8 billion, which represents growth of 13% to 15%.
In Cloud Platforms, we expect revenue of $8.7 to $8.9 billion, with growth of 22% to 24% in constant currency.
In Business Applications, we expect revenue of $6.2 to $6.3 billion.

guidance.qualitative: Decline in the low single digits
guidance.source_quote: In Devices, we expect revenue to decline in the low single digits as PC demand remains soft.
We now expect capital expenditures of approximately $38 billion, up from the $34 billion we discussed in July.
We continue to expect full-year operating margins to be roughly flat year over year.

reported.source_quote: Operating income was $7.9 billion and increased 17%
Diluted earnings per share was $2.31 and increased 13%
Revenue in Cloud Platforms was $8.2 billion and increased 24%
Revenue in Business Applications was $6.1 billion and increased 9%
Revenue in Devices was $4,300 million and increased 3%
Net income was $6.4 billion and increased 12%

tone.summary: Demand exceeds supply; capacity constrained through fiscal year-end.
tone.source_quote: Demand for our AI infrastructure services continues to exceed available supply, and we expect to remain capacity constrained through at least the end of the fiscal year.

tone.summary: Q2 operating margin down slightly on datacenter depreciation.
tone.source_quote: We expect operating margins to be down slightly year over year as we absorb higher depreciation from our datacenter build-out.

tone.summary: Longer Business Applications deal cycles, especially in Europe.
tone.source_quote: Deal cycles in Business Applications lengthened modestly this quarter, particularly in Europe, and we are planning prudently for that to continue.

tone.summary: 6% list price increase on premium tiers with minimal churn.
tone.source_quote: Pricing has held up well. We took a 6% list price increase on our premium Business Applications tiers in September and have seen minimal churn so far.
Commercial bookings grew more than 30% as customers expanded their commitments.
